scientific_interpretation: C5T preserves the authoritative C5R Reference trajectory exactly: all 65,536 state lines and 65,536 profile lines remain byte-identical under logging-only instrumentation.

The preregistered zero-fit steady-integral DSE2P route fails its mandatory numerical qualification before interface-error metrics can be fully adjudicated. At the first evaluated 70-cm interface, the deterministic physical-branch bracket cannot be established for 1,891 evaluated states.

Because all-points numerical qualification was a hard preregistered gate, this is a formal negative result for using this DSE2P numerical route as the basis of a free-running reduced model. Quadrature order, branch logic, bracket rule and tolerances are not retuned after response.

The result does not prove that every possible Darcian steady-equivalent concept is physically invalid. It establishes that the specific zero-fit monotone steady-integral formulation and numerical qualification contract selected prospectively in C5T does not provide an admissible closure route for this workload.

No C5U free-running DSE2P test is authorized. The remaining distinct closure family already retained by C5S is the storage-consistent algebraic subgrid face-profile concept, which must be derived read-only before any numerical implementation.
